TELResetTerm

Resets a terminal. 
pascal TELErr TELResetTerm (TELHandle hTEL);
hTEL
A handle to a telephone record associated with a telephone terminal.
function result
A result code.
DESCRIPTION
The TELResetTerm function resets the telephone terminal specified by the hTEL parameter, if the terminal hardware and software support resetting.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS
Not all terminals support resetting.
